One can never tell with spirits such as these. $B$BThe Unyielding are still against us and will no doubt kill you if they can.  Be careful $N.

96f18399a38ec0043b7c38b76732fccf70b31a0b.RewardText: Well done, soldier! Now the rest of the men can focus their efforts on the Horde.
